in_sanskrit.name: Shannu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shannu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Shannu is derived from the name of the Goddess Shiva, who is revered in Hinduism as the destroyer of evil and the source of all creation. This name is believed to bring grace, beauty, and the power of the sun to those who bear it.
